International Counterparty Credit Risk Definitions (English Only)

Definitions

Novation: The replacement of an existing financial contract between two counterparties with a new contract involving a central counterparty or transferee.

Haircut: A percentage reduction applied to the market value of collateral to account for price volatility and liquidation risk.

Synthetic Credit Overlay: An off-balance-sheet credit protection structure layered atop an existing treasury portfolio without transferring underlying assets.
